note: Golden + edge vectors for the PSP dispute reason-code crosswalk (PSP-DISPUTE-CROSSWALK-NODE-1). Coverage: one concept-backed golden per PSP (PayPal pinned to the schema v1.12 British UNAUTHORISED), a singleton that crosses to none, Visa and Mastercard network-code lookups, and seven named refusals (unknown PSP, the PayPal American-spelling UNAUTHORIZED vs British UNAUTHORISED distinction, unknown reason, both input shapes neither/both, unknown network, unknown network code). Every mapping cell cites a clause from research/clause-snapshots/{paypal,stripe,adyen,square}-disputes-2026-10/SNAPSHOT.md; cells with no snapshot support are none, never inferred. golden_hash pending - run `node golden-parity.test.mjs --update` to pin it.

vectors.name: refused_paypal_american_spelling
vectors.description: Refusal: PayPal UNAUTHORIZED (American spelling) is not a schema v1.12 enum value; only the British UNAUTHORISED is. REFUSED_UNKNOWN_REASON.

output_payload.detail: For psp=paypal, reason must be one of the snapshot-published values: MERCHANDISE_OR_SERVICE_NOT_RECEIVED, MERCHANDISE_OR_SERVICE_NOT_AS_DESCRIBED, UNAUTHORISED, CREDIT_NOT_PROCESSED, DUPLICATE_TRANSACTION, INCORRECT_AMOUNT, PAYMENT_BY_OTHER_MEANS, CANCELED_RECURRING_BILLING, PROBLEM_WITH_REMITTANCE, OTHER; received "UNAUTHORIZED". (PayPal spellings are schema v1.12 verbatim, including UNAUTHORISED.)

vectors.name: refused_unknown_reason
vectors.description: Refusal: a value in no snapshot vocabulary. REFUSED_UNKNOWN_REASON with the psp's published vocabulary enumerated in the detail.

output_payload.detail: For psp=stripe, reason must be one of the snapshot-published values: bank_cannot_process, check_returned, credit_not_processed, customer_initiated, debit_not_authorized, duplicate, fraudulent, general, incorrect_account_details, insufficient_funds, noncompliant, product_not_received, product_unacceptable, subscription_canceled, unrecognized; received "not_a_snapshot_reason". (PayPal spellings are schema v1.12 verbatim, including UNAUTHORISED.)

vectors.name: refused_empty_input
vectors.description: Refusal: an empty policy_parameters object carries no psp at all, so the kernel's categorical psp check fires first — REFUSED_UNKNOWN_PSP (psp undefined). A named refusal either way, never a silent guess; supplying both {psp, reason} and {network_code} is the REFUSED_INPUT_SHAPE case pinned in its own vector.

output_payload.detail: psp must be one of paypal, stripe, adyen, square; received null

vectors.name: refused_input_shape_both
vectors.description: Refusal: both {psp, reason} and {network_code} supplied. REFUSED_INPUT_SHAPE.

output_payload.detail: Provide exactly one of: {psp, reason} or {network_code: {network, code}}. Received both.

vectors.name: refused_unknown_network
vectors.description: Refusal: network_code.network outside the two snapshot-published maps (amex). REFUSED_UNKNOWN_NETWORK.

output_payload.detail: network_code.network must be visa or mastercard; received "amex". Only Visa (S5/A4) and Mastercard (S5) network maps are snapshot-supported.

vectors.name: refused_unknown_network_code
